about_the_game:
HARD. UNFAIR. ADDICTIVE.

Donald Jump is a brutal, one-button precision platformer that will push your reflexes and patience to the limit. You've got just 10 lives to survive 50 devious levels designed to crush your spirit (but somehow keep you hitting restart anyway). Can you out-jump the chaos?

ONE BUTTON. ENDLESS PAIN.

Simple to learn, impossible to master — with just one button, you’ll leap, bounce, and fumble through hazards, traps, and rage-inducing gaps. Every pixel matters. Every frame counts. Perfect for fans of games that punish mistakes but reward perseverance.

FEATURES

🟥 50 hand-crafted, punishing levels
🟥 20 lives... total. That’s it. Lose them all? Back to the start.
🟥 Tight one-button controls
🟥 No checkpoints. No mercy. Pure platforming.
🟥 A throwback to the hardest arcade and indie platformers
🟥 Perfect for speedrunners, masochists, and leaderboard chasers

COLLECTIBLE SKINS

Customize your chaos! Unlock a variety of quirky and ridiculous skins. Each is a political parody and a badge of honor earned through sheer perseverance (or stubbornness). Can you unlock them all?

🟥 Earn skins by collecting coins
🟥 A mix of funny, weird, and thematic characters
🟥 Show off your favorite look as you rage against the levels

WILL YOU MAKE THE JUMP?

Most players won’t.
